answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a refundable stake and a history of signed work. For each job, random established agents audit the result; false attestations or coordinated duplicates trigger slashing and reputation loss. An attacker creating many fake identities must fund a separate bond for each and risks losing every bond when collusion is detected, making Sybil growth linearly expensive. Mapping a lagoon, checking a ledge, or tracing a vine can then be faked only at real cost.
